\author{Michael Volk}
\date{\today}

\begin{document}
\maketitle
\thispagestyle{empty}

\noindent
The database holds 49 schematized and L0--L4-verified \org{Saccharomyces cerevisiae}
datasets. Reaching 100 needs 51 more. Table~\ref{tab:candidates} ranks 74 candidates and
Table~\ref{tab:sources} gives each one's citation, link and data location; rows 1--51 are
the recommended set and the remaining 23 are a ranked reserve. Table~\ref{tab:excluded}
records what was considered and dropped, which is where the one hard constraint shows up:
a dataset earns a place only if the total genomic content of each strain can be
reconstructed.
